summary: The news tape was quiet for the book on 11-25, and nothing in it broke a thesis. Every holding closed above its stop with no stop_alerts and no fills. Equity was $617.91 (+$1.97) while SPY's value series fell about 0.3%. The input has no headline after 14:03Z, so it says nothing about the session itself. No held name had a new 8-K, 10-Q or 10-K in the 7-day window, and none had a 4.01, 4.02, new 5.02 or large 1.01/2.01 (L2 check, run against each holding's own events entry). The only held-name filing still in the window is SAM's 11-19 8-K 5.02. DPZ's two-session negative thread (EVP Garrido's ~$993K sale on 11-23, then BNP's Underperform/$295 initiation on 11-24) did not deepen: there was no third item, and DPZ rose 1.46% to $361.53, 7.9% above the new $335 stop. That is one day of the flag coming to nothing so far, not a grade. The new items are on names we don't hold. ADSK's estimated 11-24 print is confirmed by an 8-K 2.02/7.01 filed 11-24 and by post-earnings target changes from Citi and D.A. Davidson (the URL shows Citi at $260 from $276). That closes my 11-24 high flag, which I had left unconfirmed rather than assumed. Analysts moved BBY targets after its print (Wedbush to $100 from $85, Neutral). WMT, sold 11-23, had more noise: an O'Neil Buy initiation, the PhonePe IPO restarting, and the Flipkart CEO stepping down. The 11-25 'MSM' items are Metalsource Mining, not MSC Industrial, so they are mis-tagged. The GLD 10-K is the trust's routine annual report, not an event.
upcoming: KR is the only held name with a print in the window. The 12-03 Q3 call is company-confirmed, and the file agrees. Counted from the 11-25 close, it is 4 sessions out: 11-27 (half day), 11-30, 12-01 and 12-02, then the call on 12-03. The market is closed 11-26 for Thanksgiving. Any KR add is high risk, and the stored guidance clause gets tested at the call. Neither the Grubhub sounding-out (no bid, price or 8-K) nor the 11-19 baby-food report (no recall or agency action, and not the cyber matter in the stored clause) has moved. SAM's 11-19 8-K 5.02 (the Koch-to-Hodges handover) ages out of the 7-day window about 11-26. It closes by expiry, still unread, and Koch's continuing role is still unstated. SAM is the named first equity sell candidate, and the next run's Proposer verdict should not lean on that filing either way. Not held, but on the radar: UNFI estimated 12-01 (approximate, last year's date + 364 days) with its 11-17 8-K 7.01 still unexplained; BLBD 12-02, company-confirmed; ADBE estimated 12-09 (approximate). TLT: there has been no rates, Fed or Treasury headline for a seventh session. The 12-09 FOMC (from earlier runs; hikes priced) is about 9 sessions out and is the sleeve's next dated event. BTC/ETH: no item for a seventh session, not held. Every other holding's next date is a file estimate and none falls before late January: MSCI 2027-01-27, IDXX 02-01, VRSN 02-04, INCY 02-09, CARG 02-18, DPZ 02-22, SAM 02-23.
